metadata.description: Hire an Engineer by Bilawal (github.com/bilawalbaig8): an AI senior software engineer for people who don't code, plus a live agent crew view and project board for Claude Code.

plugins.name: hire-an-engineer
plugins.description: The Hire an Engineer skill: your AI tool plans, builds, tests, ships and documents your project in plain language, and asks before anything risky. Installs the agent crew view with it.

plugins.name: agent-crew
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat that shows your AI engineering team at work: each agent as a little Claude with its model, effort and the file it is on.

plugins.name: hire-an-engineer-board
plugins.description: A live board beside the chat for projects run by the skill: tasks by stage, what waits for you, parallel lanes and the approved cap.
